_help: Optional monthly AI-tool budgets in rupees. Leave a section empty to show no budget.
departments: department display name -> monthly budget, e.g. {"Gen AI": 25000}
tools: tool name -> monthly budget, e.g. {"Kling": 30000}
total: one monthly budget for the whole company, or null.
A report period shorter or longer than a month compares against the budget pro-rated by days.
